//: C&N Jewelry's gem cutting (mod id canjewelry, checked with its 0.8.2 release): recipes/gemcutting holds one recipe per cut, a rough gem shaped by a voxel pattern into a cut gem of that gem type. Vintage-E reads them here, so cut gems are valued from the rough gem they're cut from instead of being guessed. The pattern only decides the cut's shape; no material is lost, so a recipe is one rough gem for one cut gem.
//other: Some of its cutting files are for gems another mod adds (Geology, Salt and Sands): with that mod missing, their allowedVariants match nothing and Vintage-E counts them as recipes for a mod that isn't loaded, as the game skips them.
